messages.subject: DRUG this week
parts:
Hi all,

This week at DRUG, Rosemary Hartman will give a brief presentation on her adventures in fitting general additive models (GAMs) in R.  We will meet as usual on Friday 10-12 in Plant and Environmental Sciences 2005. 

Also, good news!  We've gotten a small sponsorship of $100 from Revolution Analytics (www.revolutionanalytics.com).  I'll be using it for snacks for our meetings (suggestions welcome).  There's also an indeterminate bag of schwag coming in the mail for us.

Cheers,

Noam
